title: Report something near me — flow specification
intent: Let a person start from where the problem is, see plausible nearby BetterMakati places, confirm the right place when one exists, and still report when the place is missing or unmatched.
productRules: Location-first reporting is an alternative to searching the Civic Map; it does not replace place pages.
Nearby matching suggests candidates and never auto-selects or silently assigns a place.
A report must remain possible when no canonical place matches.
Location-only reports must not create fake Place Registry records or fake place IDs.
Only verified Place Registry records are eligible for automatic nearby suggestions.
Emergency routing, duplicate detection, evidence states, public tracking and submission fallback are preserved.
The browser must never request location permission on page load.
Exact device location is ephemeral matching input, not canonical place data.

entryPoints.directPlaceReporting: Existing place-detail Report a problem action remains available and bypasses nearby matching because the place is already known.

choices.label: Use my current location
choices.behavior: Request browser geolocation only after the user taps this choice.

choices.label: Search for a place or street
choices.behavior: Use Place Registry text search/manual selection without asking for device location.

choices.label: Choose the location manually
choices.behavior: Allow a map/pin or equivalent coordinate selection without geolocation permission.

permissionStates.granted: Use the returned point and accuracy only for the current flow.
permissionStates.denied: Do not reprompt automatically. Keep Search and Choose manually available.
permissionStates.unavailable: Show the same manual alternatives without an error dead-end.
permissionStates.lowAccuracy: Continue, but label the result approximate and require explicit place confirmation.

flow.title: Is it one of these places?
behavior: Show up to five nearby verified candidates.
Show name, category, barangay when known and approximate distance.
Always require the user to choose a candidate or choose None of these.
Provide Search another place even when nearby candidates exist.
Do not require the candidate to be in the currently selected BetterBarangay; border cases may cross barangay boundaries.

noMatchChoice.label: None of these — report this location
noMatchChoice.consequence: Continue without a canonical place ID. Require a short human-readable location description before submit.

flow.title: What is the problem?
flow.matchedPlace: Use issueCategoriesForAsset(place.primaryCategory) so the existing taxonomy remains asset-aware.

locationOnly.rule: Use a defined public-realm baseline subset of the existing civic issue taxonomy rather than exposing transport/facility-specific categories without a place context.

flow.emergencyBehavior: If an emergency category is selected, stop the civic report flow and show the existing 911 handoff. Do not submit a BetterMakati case.

flow.title: Add details
flow.matchedPlaceLocation: Keep the selected place ID and use the incident point as location context when one was supplied.
flow.locationOnlyRequirement: Require a short location description such as a corner, landmark or street stretch because no canonical place name exists.

flow.title: Review & submit
flow.submitBehavior: Hand off to the existing civic submission path with emergency filtering and duplicate detection preserved.

flow.title: Track the case
flow.success: Show the existing public BetterMakati case/tracking link.
flow.duplicate: Show existing nearby matching cases and let the user confirm/update one or create a separate case when genuinely different.
flow.fallback: Preserve the existing pre-filled GitHub fallback when native storage is unavailable.

excludedFromAutomaticMatching: transport-route, because one representative point is not a reliable proxy for an entire route
ordering: Do not infer containment from a representative point.
Do not apply hidden category or barangay preference before the user chooses the issue.

accuracyHandling.accuracy<=100m: Normal candidate list; still no auto-selection.
accuracyHandling.100m<accuracy<=250m: Label location approximate and show candidates; explicit confirmation remains mandatory.
accuracyHandling.accuracy>250m: Do not present any candidate as likely/correct. Prefer manual search or manual pin, though nearby candidates may still be shown as broad suggestions.

nearbyMatching.distanceDisplay: Round candidate distance for display; do not imply survey-grade precision.
nearbyMatching.confidenceModel: No numeric confidence score in W3R-5. Confirmation by the user is the identity decision.

locationOnlyCases.rule: Do not invent a synthetic Place Registry ID.
locationOnlyCases.duplicateDetection: For location-only reports, compare open reports with the same category within the existing 75 m duplicate radius instead of requiring identical assetId.
locationOnlyCases.registryEffect: A location-only report never creates or edits a Place Registry record. A separate Help document Makati action may later propose a missing place.

matchedPlaceCases.backwardCompatibility: Keep sending the selected stable place ID through the existing assetId field during W3R-5c so existing case pages and duplicate logic continue to work.
matchedPlaceCases.futureMetadata: Add placeId/locationMode fields when case metadata is versioned, but do not require a bulk migration of old cases.

privacy.locationPermission: Explicit user action only; no background or automatic location request.
privacy.ephemeralDevicePoint: The raw browser geolocation point and accuracy are used in memory for candidate matching and cleared when the flow ends.
privacy.persistence: Do not persist geolocation accuracy or the raw device point simply because permission was granted.
privacy.submittedIncidentPoint: When a coordinate is submitted, use the user-confirmed incident location and round to 4 decimal places before public case persistence, roughly block/10-metre scale in Makati.
privacy.analytics: Do not add location coordinates to analytics or client logs as part of W3R-5.
privacy.permissionDenial: A denied location permission must not reduce functionality beyond removing automatic nearby suggestions.

accessibilityAndMobile: The flow must work without an interactive map; candidate cards and manual text search are first-class.
Keyboard and screen-reader users must be able to complete every step.
Location permission is triggered by a labeled button, never by focus or page load.
Selected place/location remains visible while completing issue details.
Back navigation between steps retains entered details locally.
failureAndFallbackRules: Geolocation denied/unavailable → Search place or Choose manually.
No nearby candidates → Location-only remains available immediately.
Wrong candidate → Search another place or Location-only.
Place is missing → Do not force the user to document the place before reporting the problem.
Civic API unavailable → existing GitHub fallback.
Emergency category → 911 handoff, no civic case.
notInScope: Place Registry creation from user submissions
acceptanceCriteria: The specification supports reporting without first knowing a Civic Map place.
The browser never requests location before explicit user action.
Nearby suggestions use only verified registry places and never auto-select.
The user can reject all suggestions and continue with a location-only report.
Location-only reporting does not require or invent a Place Registry ID.
Emergency categories still terminate into the 911 path.
Matched-place duplicate semantics remain same place + same category + <=75 m.
Location-only duplicate semantics are same category + <=75 m.
Raw device location/accuracy is not persisted merely for matching.
The flow remains usable without geolocation permission and without an interactive map.

handoff.W3R5b: Implement candidate matching and location-selection state only. Do not submit reports yet.
handoff.W3R5c: Connect confirmed-place and location-only paths to civic submission; extend backend metadata/duplicate logic only as required by this spec.
handoff.W3R5d: Reconnect lifecycle display/relationships after the new report path is operational.

validation.promotion: The route is intentionally not linked from the Civic Map yet; W3R-5c will expose it when report submission is connected.
locationChoices: Search for a place or street
validation.permissionBehavior: Browser geolocation is requested only from the Use my current location button. Denied/unavailable states keep search and manual-coordinate alternatives available.
validation.manualSearch: Verified registry places are searchable by name, summary, barangay, address, aliases and tags.
validation.locationOnly: After a point is chosen, the user can explicitly select None of these — report this location. No synthetic place ID is created.
validation.submissionBoundary: CivicNearbyReport contains no /api/civic fetch or POST submission code.
validation.guardrail: scripts/check-place-registry.mjs now guards geolocation-on-action, verified nearby filtering, 250/500 m radii, five-candidate cap, location-only option, route registration, no submission and no premature Civic Map promotion.
validation.ci: Latest CI reports only the same three pre-existing unused-import ESLint errors. No new lint errors are reported for CivicNearbyReport.tsx, App.tsx or the Place Registry guardrail; repo build remains skipped behind the baseline lint failure.
